purpose: Read-only, verified physical source layout/content snapshots; no conversion, repair, Redump or cooked-sector equivalence claims.

reuse.reading: safe_read::open_bounded_read, no trusted roots; constant-memory exact streaming reads

record.construction: Opaque verified record; no deserialization or mutable public proof fields
record.provenance: Verified original CUE text and SHA-256, literal FILE references, canonical paths, FILE ordinals/types, device/inode/size/mtime/ctime
record.layout: Canonical track numbers/modes, INDEX 00/01, extra INDEX entries, PREGAP/POSTGAP declarations and complete timeline
record.content: SHA-256 of every whole source FILE and every program/stored-pregap range; unassigned prefix separately recorded, never called a pregap
record.relationships: FILE partitions and identity aliases, including hard links

verification: Inspect bounded CUE snapshot and all safely opened backing-file identities.
Reuse canonical parser and timeline; refuse unrepresented directives, unused FILE declarations and descending extra INDEX numbers.
Validate CUE bytes, FILE resolution and all source identities before hashing.
Hash each complete source and its contiguous range partition in one pass; synthetic gaps produce no bytes or digest.
Check descriptor identity after each source.
Re-read CUE and re-resolve its FILE references, then recheck all source identities before returning the record.

comparison.Equivalent: Only two successfully verified supported snapshots with matching FILE partitions/aliases/types/sizes, track modes/relationships, all declared indexes/gaps/boundaries and every stored byte digest.
comparison.Different: Typed differences in stored pregap/program/source bytes, indexes/boundaries, pregap storage, synthetic declarations or source relationships.
comparison.Unsupported: Unsafe references, malformed/truncated layout, unsupported byte mapping/directives/limits/platform or ambiguity; identical refusals are never equivalent.
comparison.Indeterminate: Missing/unreadable backing files or CUE, failed reads, or changed identities/FILE relationships.
comparison.programs_match: Physical program bytes/modes only; never establishes whole-layout, cooked-sector, CHD or Redump equivalence.
comparison.normalization: Absolute source names, machine-local identities and harmless REM COMMENT/GENRE text are provenance. Physical aliases and FILE partitioning remain comparison facts. Optional zero-length gap declarations are retained.

supported: On Unix, regular readable BINARY source files with canonical unambiguous consecutive tracks, whole sectors and a consistent sector width per FILE. MODE1/2048, MODE1/2352, MODE2/2352 and AUDIO permit physical-byte evidence, including same-width mixed tracks and multiple FILEs. This adds no sector decoding or conversion support.

limits.memory: CUE text, bounded layout and range metadata, and one fixed read buffer; never load a BIN into memory.

limitations: Non-Unix systems refuse evidence until stable source identities can be proved.
WAVE and other FILE mappings, mixed sector widths within one FILE, CD-text, flags, catalog/ISRC/session metadata and other unrepresented directives remain explicitly unsupported.
INDEX 00 together with PREGAP remains ambiguous and refused by the existing canonical timeline.

Frozen snapshots compare the inspected bytes and relationships; they neither lock source files nor authorize later changes. Source identities/relationships must be checked again for any later operation.
Synthetic gaps are declarations only; no silence is invented or hashed.
Physical-byte evidence does not prove decoded audio, disc readability, original mastering information or Redump equivalence.

The CUE anchor must be an absolute, normal, nonsymlink path satisfying the shared safe-read policy. Relative FILE references are resolved by the canonical parser and checked again before proof publication.
